Class SocketClientHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.network.server.SocketClientHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
ClientConnection, Runnable
public class SocketClientHandler extends Object implements ClientConnection, Runnable
Server-side TCP handler for one connected client.

Each client uses three threads:

  • reader: reads inbound messages on the main handler thread via run().
  • writer: drains the outbound BlockingQueue.
  • watchdog: every 5000L ms, checks whether the client has sent any message during the last 30000L ms; on timeout it closes the connection.

disconnectReported guarantees that the session is notified once: both the read loop and watchdog can detect disconnection, but only the first one reports it.
